blueprints.name: High-Density Operational Data Table
invariants: Must implement all 4 states: Initial Skeleton (matching exact row height), Empty State (with clear CTA or filter reset), Error Banner (with retry trigger), and Populated Data.
All numeric, currency, percentage, latency, and timestamp columns MUST enforce `tabular-nums` (`font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums`) and right-alignment (`text-right`).
Long text cells (emails, titles, UUIDs) MUST have `min-w-0` + `truncate` (`text-overflow: ellipsis`) so a single 200-char string never blows out table width.
Interactive action cells (Edit/Delete icon buttons) MUST have explicit `aria-label` and >= 36px–44px hit targets.
mobile_native_rules: Wrap table in `overflow-x-auto overscroll-x-contain` with subtle horizontal scroll indicators so mobile viewports never break page width.
Filter search `<input>` must use `text-base sm:text-sm` (>= 16px on mobile) to prevent iOS Safari forced zoom.
Row action triggers must meet 44x44px touch target on coarse pointers (`pointer: coarse`).

blueprints.name: Accessible Scale-95 Dialog Modal
invariants: Never animate modal from `scale(0)` — always enter from `scale(0.95)` + `opacity: 0` over 150ms–180ms with `cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1)`.
Must trap keyboard focus inside dialog (`role="dialog" aria-modal="true" aria-labelledby=...`), support `Escape` key dismissal, and restore focus to trigger on close.
Destructive confirmation modals must clearly separate Cancel and Confirm buttons and disable/show spinner during async mutation (`isSubmitting`) to prevent double-submit.
Modal body must have `max-h-[85dvh] overflow-y-auto` so tall content scrolls internally without clipping off-screen.
mobile_native_rules: Stack action buttons full-width (`flex-col-reverse sm:flex-row`) with 44px minimum height on mobile so thumb reach is effortless.

blueprints.name: Physics-Driven Slide-Over & Bottom Sheet
invariants: Animate strictly via GPU `transform: translate3d(...)` with `cubic-bezier(0.32, 0.72, 0, 1)`; never animate `right`, `bottom`, or `width`.
Provide sticky header with explicit close button (`aria-label="Close panel"`) and sticky footer for primary save/cancel actions.
Respect `100dvh` on side drawers and `max-h-[92dvh]` on mobile bottom sheets with `pb-[env(safe-area-inset-bottom)]`.
mobile_native_rules: Use `h-[100dvh]` for side drawers and `max-h-[90dvh]` for bottom sheets.
Include a visual drag handle pill on mobile bottom sheets and ensure close button hit area is >= 44x44px.

blueprints.name: Keyboard-First Command Palette (Cmd+K)
invariants: Search input MUST use `text-base` (16px) so mobile devices never auto-zoom on focus, and include `role="combobox" aria-expanded="true" aria-controls="cmd-list"`.
Must handle empty search results gracefully (`No commands found for "..."`) without collapsing container width.
Keyboard shortcut badges (`⌘K`, `↑↓`, `↵`) must use monospace font and `tabular-nums`.
mobile_native_rules: Position palette near the top (`top-[12dvh]`) so the mobile on-screen keyboard never obscures the results list.
Search input must be `text-base` (>= 16px) with `autoCapitalize="none" autoCorrect="off"`.

blueprints.name: Accessible Form Field with Inline Validation
invariants: Every `<input>`, `<select>`, and `<textarea>` MUST have a persistent visible `<label htmlFor=...>` (placeholder is never a substitute for a label).
Error states must bind `aria-invalid={Boolean(error)}` and `aria-describedby` pointing to both helper text and error message IDs.
Input font size MUST be `text-base sm:text-sm` (16px on mobile, 14px on desktop) so mobile browsers never trigger forced viewport zoom.
mobile_native_rules: Enforce `text-base sm:text-sm` on all form inputs (`16px` minimum on mobile).
Use accurate `inputMode` (`numeric`, `email`, `tel`, `url`) and `autoComplete` tokens to summon the right mobile keyboard.

blueprints.name: WCAG AA Semantic Status Badge (5 States)
invariants: Must cover all 5 operational states (`draft`, `pending`, `success`, `error`, `info`) with >= 4.5:1 text contrast ratio against the badge background.
Never rely on color alone — pair each status with a clear text label and optional semantic indicator dot.
Use `whitespace-nowrap` and subtle 1px border token (`border-current/20`) so badges remain crisp in both light and dark themes.
mobile_native_rules: Keep badges compact (`px-2 py-0.5 text-xs`) with `shrink-0` inside flex containers so they never wrap mid-word.

blueprints.name: Asymmetric Telemetry Bento Grid (Anti-Slop)
invariants: Avoid the generic AI-slop '3 equal cards in a row with centered icons' pattern; use purposeful asymmetric column spans (`md:col-span-2`, `md:col-span-1`) driven by information hierarchy.
Every card must have `min-w-0` and overflow protection so long titles or large numbers (`$999,999,999.00`) never break grid track widths.
All numeric KPIs and delta percentages must enforce `tabular-nums`.
mobile_native_rules: Collapse cleanly to a single column (`grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3`) on mobile viewports with consistent `gap-4`.
